title: extract_response: name the tuple fields at the use site
description: In client.rs extract_response, the code accesses inv.0, inv.1, inv.2 on an Invocation (a (String, Value, String) tuple alias). The comment one line above says what the fields are, but a contributor reading only this function sees positional tuple indexing with no field names. The comment is accurate but placed on the wrong line — it appears before the let binding, not adjacent to the .0/.1/.2 accesses. Consider a destructuring let (method_name, args, _id) = inv at the top of the function so all three accesses are self-documenting.
